hs: Sawn timber, stakes and special projects, from the Amazon to the world.
a1: Founded in 2006, Nova Era has two decades in the timber industry, producing sawn timber for construction and, on a smaller scale, for joinery.
a2: Our timber comes from monitored forest management projects and long-standing commercial relationships. This gives us a solid chain of custody that supports compliance with Brazilian, European (EUDR) and US (Lacey Act) legislation.
a3: We work with tropical hardwoods of high durability and long service life, often reusable, which means savings over time.
a4: Since 2019 we have made hardwood stakes from material that would otherwise become charcoal or biomass, creating jobs and income in our region.
d1: Deep technical knowledge to support each client
d2: Many species available throughout the year
d4: Our own port, which speeds up order logistics
